verdict.rationale: The docs mention a desktop app where you can open your dot's profile and inspect delegated work, so dots has some desktop-app presence. Connecting your computer exposes local files, code and apps, but that is not screen access. There is no evidence of OS-level shortcuts or of the dot seeing what is on your screen. missing for 10: OS-level global shortcuts, access to on-screen content, dedicated desktop-app documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can use an official desktop app with OS-level shortcuts and access to what is on my screen

citations.quote: In the desktop app, open your dot's profile and select Activity to inspect delegated work
